credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: View of famous rock formation in Yosemite named Half Dome, dead arching tree in foreground with clouds and sky in background. This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Half Dome
